program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((marker (find-first (lambda (p)
                               (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                                 (or (= v 1) (= v 2) (= v 3) (= v 4))))
                             (grid-positions g)))
         (mcolor (at g (first marker) (second marker)))
         (delta (cond [(= mcolor 1) (list 0 -1)]
                      [(= mcolor 2) (list -1 0)]
                      [(= mcolor 3) (list 0 1)]
                      [else (list 1 0)])))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (let ((nr (+ (first p) (first delta))) (nc (+ (second p) (second delta))))
               (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                   (set-cell out nr nc 6)
                   out)))
           (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
           (find-color g 6))))
